an3.94:1.1: tamagataṁ → tamaṁ (sya-all, pts) | abbhussakkamāno → abbhussukkamāno (pts) | abbhussakkamāno → abbhosasukkamāno (bj: machasaṁ) | abbhussakkamāno → abbhussukkamāno (cck: sī. pī.)
an3.94:2.1: uppajjati saha dassanuppādā → udapādi sahadassanuppādā (bj, pts) | dhammacakkhuṁ uppajjati saha dassanuppādā → dhammacakkhakha udapādi sahadassanuppādā (sya-all) | uppajjati → udapādi (cck: sabbattha)
an3.94:3.3: tasmiñce → tasmiṁ (bj, pts) | āgaccheyyāti tatiyaṁ → āgaccheyyā ti (pts) | taṁ → tassa (cck: ka.) | imaṁ → punayimaṁ (cck: syā. kaṁ. ka.)
